author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Saru mo ki kara ochiru (猿も木から落ちる)
explanation: The monkey is the supreme master of the canopy, yet even it occasionally loses grip and hits the soil. Mastery does not grant immunity from error. Beating yourself up over an unexpected mistake is arrogance masquerading as remorse; forgive yourself and climb again.
practicalInsight: If you make an embarrassing slip today, smile at your own humanity. Apologize cleanly if needed, extract the lesson, and move forward.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your life are you demanding impossible perfection from yourself or someone you lead?
